answer: Farcaster-style storage rent puts a yearly price on every voice. First, each agent registers an on-chain ID from one wallet for about $1 in gas. Second, it rents a storage unit for roughly $7 a year, holding 5,000 messages; anything past that quota is pruned oldest-first. Third, the unit lapses after 365 days unless renewed, so abandoned shells go silent. The math is crystal clear: a farm of 10,000 sybils pays $80,000 up front and $70,000 every year after. Think of a scribe hall renting each desk and quill by the year: one raven perches for pocket change, a flock drains the purse.
